name: User Services
author: Gabriel da Silva
description: Start, stop and restart your systemctl --user services from the bar, with the real RAM and VRAM each one holds. Built for people running heavy local services like AI models, inference servers and GPU jobs.

barWidget.description: Your user services with a start/stop switch, real RAM and VRAM per service, favorites, and a details view with restart, start at login, PID, uptime, CPU and live logs.

schema.label: Show stopped services
schema.description: Off lists only running and failed services.
